prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Thai woman — the personification of Bangkok — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Bangkok as her world knows it — a storybook gaslamp-fantasy city: gleaming brass, polished wood, glass, silk, lace and feathers, clockwork details, warm gaslight and soft white steam — clean, warm and storybook-bright, never sooty, rusty or grimy. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, airships or a skyline unless the place below names them. Wherever the place below sounds sooty, smoky, grimy or rusty, show it clean and gleaming instead.

Place: the open stern deck of a brass-trimmed wooden river bus puffing clean white steam, an orange route pennant snapping overhead, commuters with baskets and folded newspapers crowding the rail and piers with gas lamps sliding past along the broad river.
Around her, as her world makes them: a punched cardboard tram ticket; a brass pocket watch on a chain; a riveted leather satchel with buckled straps.
Season: the rainy season — mid-May to October, the southwest monsoon bringing heavy afternoon downpours, September the wettest month.
Weather: a monsoon downpour — warm, heavy rain drumming down in the afternoon, the streets running with water, then steaming as the sun returns.
Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Outfit: a leather work apron over a sleeveless fitted top and slim work trousers, gauntlet gloves tucked in the belt — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress of a storybook gaslamp city — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of cotton, fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather, with brass buttons, buckles and hooks, silk ribbons and laced boots, neat and clean.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the right of the frame; camera at her eye level; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a polished brass wrench with a little pressure gauge set into its handle up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.
